summary: Four armed police officers move with flashlights down the blackened hall of the fire-gutted Heart O' The City Hotel and take positions on either side of Room 303. The biggest cop kicks the door in and the others pour in behind him with guns thrust forward, shouting 'Police! Freeze!' The room is nearly bare, lit only by the glow of a computer sitting on a fold-up table with a modem and powerbook. Trinity, a woman in black leather, is at the keyboard. When the big cop orders 'Hands behind your head! Now! Do it!', she complies, slowly putting her hands behind her head.

what_changes.before: Sitting alone at the computer, undiscovered and unseized, 'her hands still on the keyboard'.
what_changes.after: Surrounded by guns and ordered to submit, she yields: 'She slowly puts her hands behind her head.'
what_changes.evidence: She slowly puts her hands behind her head.

what_changes.before: Cautious, creeping with the others, 'ready themselves on either side of Room 303.'
what_changes.after: Bursts in and commands the room: 'Hands behind your head! Now! Do it!'
what_changes.evidence: The biggest of them violently kicks in the door. The other cops pour in behind him, guns thrust before them.

event_hint.one_line: Armed police breach Room 303 of the abandoned hotel and take Trinity into custody at gunpoint.

uncertain: Whether Trinity surrenders willingly or is setting a trap — her slow compliance is ambiguous.
What Trinity was doing on the computer before the cops entered.
Whether the other three POLICE OFFICERS speak or only the BIG COP.
_mind_pass: ran: 1 speaker, 155w >= p75 (125w) for this work

minds.wants: To finish whatever she was doing at the keyboard — to buy the seconds she needs — before submitting to the raid without giving them a reason to think she is dangerous.
minds.feels: Alert and controlled, not panicked. She has registered the breach, assessed that armed resistance here gains her nothing, and is choosing compliance as the cheaper exit rather than being overwhelmed by fear.
minds.shows: Only stillness at the keyboard, then slow, obedient movement of her hands behind her head — the picture of a cornered woman doing exactly as told.
minds.basis: The summary flags her surrender as ambiguous ('Whether Trinity surrenders willingly or is setting a trap — her slow compliance is ambiguous'), and the scene gives 'her hands still on the keyboard' then 'She slowly puts her hands behind her head.' The slowness is the legible detail: it is deliberate, not the jerk of a startled captive. The event shape (ev-001) confirms she will defeat this squad moments later, so her compliance is tactical, not genuine defeat.

believes_about.belief: He believes he has caught a lone hacker at the end of her options — a criminal who will fold under guns and shouted orders.
believes_about.wrong_because: He has breached a room whose occupant is a trained operative; the dominance he just seized is about to be inverted when she turns the squad.

minds.wants: To seize the occupant of Room 303 cleanly and assert total control of the space before she can destroy anything or reach for a weapon.
minds.feels: Wired and dominant — the adrenaline of the kick, the breach, and the shouted commands, coupled with the vigilance of a man who does not yet know whether the room is safe.
minds.shows: Pure authority: the violent kick, guns thrust forward, the barked 'Police! Freeze!' and 'Hands behind your head! Now! Do it!' — nothing of his caution is visible once he is commanding.
minds.basis: He 'violently kicks in the door,' leads the entry with 'guns thrust before them,' and escalates his commands from 'Freeze!' to 'Hands behind your head! Now! Do it!' — the escalation shows him pressing for immediate, unambiguous submission rather than trusting the first order to hold.

believes_about.belief: He reads her as a cornered suspect whose slow compliance means he has won — the raid went exactly to plan.
believes_about.wrong_because: Her slowness is calculation, not capitulation; he mistakes the first move of a trap for a surrender, and ev-001 shows she is about to leave him and the squad beaten.

connects_back: The abandoned, fire-gutted Heart O' The City Hotel is the location ev-001 names as the target of the police raid on Trinity.
Trinity alone at a modem/powerbook mid-crack is consistent with ev-001's 'working on a computer' when the squad storms in.
sets_up: The moment of apparent custody that ev-001 inverts when Trinity turns the squad and becomes the only one standing.
The Agents' arrival to assert jurisdiction and the revelation that these officers are already dead.
The rooftop chase that follows her escape from this room.
dramatic_function: It stages a clean, conventional police victory — a lone suspect taken at gunpoint — purely so the story can pull the rug: the scene's calm surrender is the bait that makes the coming inversion (a captive who was never in danger of losing) land with force, and it introduces Trinity as someone whose obedience is a choice, not a weakness.
